Grass Fed Beef.
Pure, Local, and Raised with Purpose.
Doing it the right way since 1969

At Baldwin Beef, our cattle roam freely across thousands of acres of lush, chemical-free pasture, grazing on nutrient-rich, high-protein grasses. 

We use a year-round grazing system to produce our all-natural beef on a sustainable, multi-generation cattle ranch in Central NC. Processed at local USDA facilities and fresh-frozen, we offer dozens of standard cuts in kitchen ready, vacuum-sealed packages. Our meat is available in-store, shipped, and for pickup at Farmers Markets.

The Baldwin Mission

At Baldwin Beef, our mission is simple yet powerful: to produce chemical-free, all-natural, grass-fed beef that delivers superior health benefits, quality, and flavor. We honor time-tested, sustainable farming techniques and remain committed to a farm-to-family approach—because you deserve to know and trust the source of your food.

The Baldwin Guarantee

Our promise is simple: If our all-natural beef doesn’t meet or exceed your expectations, we’ll refund your purchase—no questions asked.

We can offer this guarantee because we know the quality of our beef. It starts with carefully bred calves from a mama cow herd we’ve spent over 60 years developing. From birth to pasture to maturity, our farm family oversees every step—raising healthy, grass-fed steers to 1,200–1,300 lbs.

This full-circle care and accountability make Baldwin Beef truly unique.
Order with confidence—and enjoy every bite.
